messages:
jordan: Heads up — CI on main is red. tests/test_snapshot_render.py::test_serialized_prompt failed with a golden diff during the nightly job. build: https://ci.internal.redwood/12345 :frowning:
ci-bot: Build 12345 • FAILED • failing test: test_serialized_prompt
ci-bot: ```
AssertionError: Snapshot mismatch for prompt_render_serialized
- expected: \"User:\n  name: \"Alex\"\n  note: \'hello\'\n\"
+ actual:   \"User:\n  name: \"Alex\"\n  note: \'hello\'\n   \n\"
```
maria: ack. looks like an extra trailing newline sneaking into serialization. any idea which change could cause it? @sam or @lee — you touched serializer last week?
sam: I touched kv-cache serialization around 2 days ago, but only for binary-compat guards. i'll take a quick look. can someone rerun the failing test locally and paste the full difflog? trying to avoid a noisy PR revert.
jordan: thanks. local repro steps in case helpful:
```
git fetch origin && git checkout main
python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e .[test]
pytest tests/test_snapshot_render.py::test_serialized_prompt -q
```
lee: quick note — the nightly runner sets REDWOOD_SNAP_UPDATE=false and a custom TZ. sometimes TZ differences add trailing whitespace in our formatter.
maria: good catch. @lee what's the TZ on the failing job? ci-bot: runner metadata: tz=UTC, python=3.10.8, env.REDWOOD_SNAP_UPDATE=false
sam: i'm running locally now. if anyone else can try `pytest -k serialized_prompt -q -s` with `export TZ=UTC` that would help rule out local env drift.
jordan: also try `git bisect` if it repros consistently: `git bisect start HEAD origin/main -- pytest tests/test_snapshot_render.py::test_serialized_prompt -q` — that'll narrow commit range quickly.
sam: local run reproduced. diff looks like one extra blank line between YAML blocks. grabbing snippet:
```
@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 User:
   name: "Alex"
-  note: 'hello'
+  note: 'hello'
+
```
lee: that pattern matches the serialization change I made in 2c9b1f9 (pretty-printer spacing tweak). I added a trailing newline to separate sections. I can open a PR to conditionally strip that when generating snapshots.
maria: thanks. if it's intentional formatting change we should update the golden, but let's confirm nothing else regressed. can we run the upstream snapshot suite and compare counts?
jordan: running full snapshot suite on my laptop now. ETA ~8m. if it's just this test, we can either update the golden or adapt the serializer to preserve prior behavior. @sam what's your preference?
sam: prefer preserving behavior unless the trailing newline fixes a real readability bug. for now, let's make a minimal fix: skip adding newline when serializing single-field blocks. lee, can you draft a patch? i'll run the bisect to confirm 2c9b1f9 is the first bad commit.
lee: will do. pushing a small change to conditionally suppress the extra newline, will run unit tests and snapshot suite, then open PR with description and link to this thread.
jordan: nice. also, for CI hygiene, can we add a smoke that normalizes trailing newlines so golden tests are less flaky? low priority but helpful.
maria: noted — created a GH issue #412: "Normalize trailing newlines in snapshot golden comparisons". tagging as P2.
sam: bisect result: 2c9b1f9 introduced the diff. confirming.
lee: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/678 — includes unit test and change. cc @jordan @sam
jordan: running CI rerun on the failing job now: triggered rebuild 12346
ci-bot: Rebuild 12346 queued by jordan
ci-bot: Rebuild 12346 • PASSED • all snapshot tests green ✅
maria: yay :tada: thanks everyone. leaving notes in the PR about the TZ and test runner env.
lee: cool. I'll backport the fix to the stable branch since this was causing nightly noise.
jordan: great follow-through. closing the quick triage — feel free to ping if anything else pops up :thumbsup:
